notes.title: 😈Dark Succubus😈 The new costume, "Transparent Black Tights" fast view
notes.notes:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/45715450/c21aed8695c44a5c7ebbf148c2e27c46ccf47c34.png[/img]
We've chosen short hair, a translucent black tights, over-the-knee stockings, low-top boots, and translucent black gloves.
This character will look really cool.
What are your thoughts? What adjustments would you like to see? Feel free to leave a comment, follow us, or add it to your wishlist.
 It has been designed and is ready for inclusion in the game.
